products.title: Wm24 White Almond
products.body_html:
WM24 is Womsh’s new design: an incredibly lightweight and soft sneaker, designed to offer you the ultimate in versatility and functionality.
The perfect balance between comfort and elegance, it adapts naturally to both urban and casual looks, as well as to more formal occasions.
Thanks to its lightness and pleasant walking, it will become your ideal ally to face every day with style and dynamism.

Upper: 100% Leather

Lining: 60% Leather, 40% Cotton

Sole:  100%  TR Light Rubber

products.title: Wave2 Nude Tiffany
products.body_html:
Wave2 is the sneaker with a thousand faces, perfect for city walkers but also for those who want to get off the beaten track. It features a consistent sole designed to support and follow the ergonomics of the foot and a variety of fabrics and materials for the upper to meet everyone's needs.

Upper: 95% leather, 5% pet

Lining: 60% cotton, 40% microfibre

Sole: 100% EVA

products.title: Vegan Hyper White Rose Metallic
products.body_html:
Hyper are the sustainable sneakers that combine a romantic interpretation of street style and a vintage reference to the 80s. They are comfortable and versatile. The upper on this model is made of Uppeal™, an innovative material that reproduces the texture and characteristics of leather using fibres derived from apple processing waste. The WOMSH logo is on the heel. The sole is 2.5 cm high.

Upper: 100% Uppeal™ 30% cotton fabric

Lining: 80% cotton sponge and 20% microline

Insole: 100% pu

Sole: 100% TR light

Sole height: 2,5 cm
